sources.name: NBS microdata catalogue
sources.notes: Public statistical tables. Microdata files that require an application are not ingested.

datasets.name: Consumer price index and inflation
datasets.description: Composite, food and core CPI plus state all-items index and year-on change from the September 2026 tables.
datasets.methodology: National Bureau of Statistics composite CPI, Table 1 of the September 2026 workbook, titled Base 2024 = 100. Index levels, month-on change and year-on change are stored as printed in that workbook. Gazette does not recompute inflation from the index. The table includes a linked history on the 2024 = 100 base. Early 2025 press releases, including the February 2025 CPI report, quoted a January 2025 headline year-on-year rate of 24.48 percent during the rebase. The September 2026 table prints about 27.61 percent for January 2025, equal to the year-on-year change of the linked index in the same table. Those vintages are not interchangeable. November 2009 = 100 workbooks were inspected and are not loaded.
datasets.limitations: State year-on change is published for September 2026 only. State index levels are published for the three months in Table 5. Labour-market rates are not in this dataset. File: https://microdata.nigerianstat.gov.ng/index.php/catalog/154/download/1440

datasets.name: Quarterly real GDP
datasets.description: Quarterly real growth and sector shares at 2019 constant prices, Q1 2024 through Q2 2026.
datasets.publicationTitle: Nigerian Gross Domestic Product Report, Q2 2026 tables
datasets.methodology: Real growth rates are percentage changes in GDP at 2019 constant basic prices, printed in the Q2 2026 GDP workbook. The quarterly total is the row 'GDP at 2019 constant price'. Agriculture, industries and services growth rates are the GROWTH block of the broad-sector sheet. Sector shares are the CONTRIBUTION TO GDP block and are shares of real GDP, not growth rates. Annual real growth for 2020–2023 is 'GDP at Constant Basic Price' in the 2019–2024 rebasing tables. Annual rates for 2024 and 2025 are the annual total columns of the Q2 2026 workbook. The 2024 annual rate agrees across those publications at 3.38 percent. Nominal GDP and the older 2010-price workbook are not mixed into these series.
datasets.limitations: Nominal GDP is a different series and is not included. Sector shares must not be read as growth rates. File: https://microdata.nigerianstat.gov.ng/index.php/catalog/147/download/1433

datasets.name: Annual real GDP growth
datasets.description: Annual real GDP growth at 2019 constant prices, 2020 through 2025.
datasets.methodology: Real growth rates are percentage changes in GDP at 2019 constant basic prices, printed in the Q2 2026 GDP workbook. The quarterly total is the row 'GDP at 2019 constant price'. Agriculture, industries and services growth rates are the GROWTH block of the broad-sector sheet. Sector shares are the CONTRIBUTION TO GDP block and are shares of real GDP, not growth rates. Annual real growth for 2020–2023 is 'GDP at Constant Basic Price' in the 2019–2024 rebasing tables. Annual rates for 2024 and 2025 are the annual total columns of the Q2 2026 workbook. The 2024 annual rate agrees across those publications at 3.38 percent. Nominal GDP and the older 2010-price workbook are not mixed into these series.
datasets.limitations: 2020–2023 come from the rebasing tables. 2024–2025 come from the Q2 2026 quarterly workbook's annual columns. The 2010-price GDP file is excluded. File: https://microdata.nigerianstat.gov.ng/index.php/catalog/147/download/1257

indicators.name: Real GDP growth, quarterly
indicators.description: Quarterly real GDP growth at 2019 constant basic prices.
indicators.methodology: Real growth rates are percentage changes in GDP at 2019 constant basic prices, printed in the Q2 2026 GDP workbook. The quarterly total is the row 'GDP at 2019 constant price'. Agriculture, industries and services growth rates are the GROWTH block of the broad-sector sheet. Sector shares are the CONTRIBUTION TO GDP block and are shares of real GDP, not growth rates. Annual real growth for 2020–2023 is 'GDP at Constant Basic Price' in the 2019–2024 rebasing tables. Annual rates for 2024 and 2025 are the annual total columns of the Q2 2026 workbook. The 2024 annual rate agrees across those publications at 3.38 percent. Nominal GDP and the older 2010-price workbook are not mixed into these series.

observations.publicationTitle: Nigerian Gross Domestic Product Report, Q2 2026 tables
observations.methodology: Real growth rates are percentage changes in GDP at 2019 constant basic prices, printed in the Q2 2026 GDP workbook. The quarterly total is the row 'GDP at 2019 constant price'. Agriculture, industries and services growth rates are the GROWTH block of the broad-sector sheet. Sector shares are the CONTRIBUTION TO GDP block and are shares of real GDP, not growth rates. Annual real growth for 2020–2023 is 'GDP at Constant Basic Price' in the 2019–2024 rebasing tables. Annual rates for 2024 and 2025 are the annual total columns of the Q2 2026 workbook. The 2024 annual rate agrees across those publications at 3.38 percent. Nominal GDP and the older 2010-price workbook are not mixed into these series.

The quarterly total is the row 'GDP at 2019 constant price'. Agriculture, industries and services growth rates are the GROWTH block of the broad-sector sheet. Sector shares are the CONTRIBUTION TO GDP block and are shares of real GDP, not growth rates. Annual real growth for 2020–2023 is 'GDP at Constant Basic Price' in the 2019–2024 rebasing tables. Annual rates for 2024 and 2025 are the annual total columns of the Q2 2026 workbook. The 2024 annual rate agrees across those publications at 3.38 percent. Nominal GDP and the older 2010-price workbook are not mixed into these series.

Annual rates for 2024 and 2025 are the annual total columns of the Q2 2026 workbook. The 2024 annual rate agrees across those publications at 3.38 percent.
